metas.name: Ted Lasso
metas.description: American college football coach Ted Lasso is hired to manage AFC Richmond, a struggling English soccer club, and must win over skeptical players, staff, and fans.

metas.name: The Gentlemen
metas.description: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to a huge weed empire, and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

metas.name: Coven Academy
metas.description: Teen witch apprentices band together to defend New Orleans against an approaching dark force.

metas.name: A Different World
metas.description: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at Hillman College, her parents' HBCU alma mater, where she must escape their shadow and build her own legacy.

metas.name: Brothers
metas.description: McConaughey and Harrelson they try to live together on a Texas ranch. That close space puts their friendship to the test.

metas.name: Best Medicine
metas.description: A brilliant surgeon leaves Boston to become a small-town doctor where he spent childhood summers. Despite his medical skills, his rude manner alienates locals as he battles hidden phobias and struggles with personal connections.

metas.name: Youth
metas.description: A 50-year-old divorcee juggles dating life while taking care of her parents and adult son.

metas.name: South Park
metas.description: The misadventures of four foul-mouthed, dirty-minded, irreverent grade-schoolers who live in the quiet, dysfunctional mountain town of South Park, Colorado.

metas.name: Scrubs
metas.description: JD and Turk scrub in together after a long break. Medicine and interns have evolved, but their friendship remains strong. New and familiar faces at Sacred Heart bring laughs, emotion, and unexpected moments.

metas.name: The Office
metas.description: A mockumentary on a group of typical office workers, where the workday consists of ego clashes, inappropriate behavior, tedium and romance.

metas.name: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia
metas.description: Five friends with big egos and small brains are the proprietors of an Irish pub in Philadelphia.

metas.name: R.J. Decker
metas.description: Ex-con photographer RJ Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

metas.name: The Lowdown
metas.description: A determined bookstore owner in Tulsa moonlights as an investigative journalist, digging into local corruption. When his reporting uncovers sinister connections, he must protect both his family and the truth.

metas.name: Ghosts
metas.description: A young couple, Sam and Jay, inherit a haunted mansion and, unaware of their invisible housemates, plan to turn it into a B&B. Their lives become much more complicated after a fall causes Sam to see the ghosts. Based on the UK ser...

metas.name: Rick and Morty
metas.description: The fractured domestic lives of a nihilistic mad scientist and his anxious grandson are further complicated by their inter-dimensional misadventures.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A group of actors move to Los Angeles to make it big, but end up working as caterers.

metas.name: Succession
metas.description: The Roy family is known for controlling the biggest media and entertainment company in the world. However, their world changes when their father steps down from the company.

metas.name: Ludwig
metas.description: While seeking to unravel the mystery of his twin brother's disappearance, reclusive puzzle-designer John 'Ludwig' Taylor takes on his twin brother James's identity as DCI on Cambridge's major crimes squad.

metas.name: The Bear
metas.description: A young chef from the fine dining world returns to Chicago to run his family's sandwich shop.

metas.name: The Boys
metas.description: A group of vigilantes set out to take down corrupt superheroes who abuse their superpowers.

metas.name: The White Lotus
metas.description: The exploits of various guests and employees of a luxury resort over the span of a week.

metas.name: Small Prophets
metas.description: Eccentric Michael Sleep, whose darling partner, Clea, disappeared seven years ago, sets out to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future.

metas.name: Gilmore Girls
metas.description: A dramedy centering around the relationship between a thirtysomething single mother and her teen daughter living in Stars Hollow, Connecticut.

metas.name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
metas.description: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom, from The Big Bang Theory (2007), returns in a new series where he attempts—and apparently fails—to save the universe, staying true to his unlucky nature.

metas.name: Friends
metas.description: The personal and professional lives of six friends living in the Manhattan borough of New York City.

metas.name: Shameless
metas.description: A scrappy, feisty, fiercely loyal Chicago family makes no apologies.

metas.name: Tires
metas.description: Will, an unqualified heir, attempts to turn his auto repair business around while enduring torment from his now-employee cousin Shane.

metas.name: The Big Bang Theory
metas.description: The lives of four socially awkward scientists take a wild turn when a beautiful and free-spirited girl moves in next door.

metas.name: Adults
metas.description: A twenty-something ensemble comedy centering on codependent housemates navigating adulthood together despite their flaws.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: Three different, but related, families face trials and tribulations in their own uniquely comedic ways.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: A grieving therapist starts to tell his clients exactly what he thinks. Ignoring his training and ethics, he finds himself making huge changes to people's lives - including his own.

metas.name: The Simpsons
metas.description: The satiric half-hour adventures of a working-class family in the misfit city of Springfield.

metas.name: Wednesday
metas.description: Follows Wednesday Addams' years as a student, when she attempts to master her emerging psychic ability, thwart a killing spree, and solve the mystery that embroiled her parents.

metas.name: Nobody Wants This
metas.description: An agnostic sex podcaster and a newly single rabbi fall in love; discovering if their relationship can survive their wildly different lives and meddling families.

metas.name: Suits
metas.description: On the run from a drug deal gone bad, brilliant college dropout Mike Ross finds himself working with Harvey Specter, one of New York City's best lawyers.

metas.name: Scrubs
metas.description: In the unreal world of Sacred Heart Hospital, intern John "J.D." Dorian learns the ways of medicine, friendship and life.

metas.name: Beef
metas.description: A minor conflict spirals into a consuming feud between two individuals, exposing pride, resentment, and hidden pain.

metas.name: Ted
metas.description: It's 1993, and Ted the bear's moment of fame has passed. He's living back home with his best friend, John Bennett, and his family. While Ted may be a lousy influence on John, he's a loyal pal who will go out on a limb for friendship.

metas.name: Hacks
metas.description: Explores a dark mentorship that forms between Deborah Vance, a legendary Las Vegas comedian, and an entitled, outcast 25-year-old.

metas.name: Fleabag
metas.description: Series adapted from the award-winning play about a young woman trying to cope with life in London whilst coming to terms with a recent tragedy.

metas.name: Colin from Accounts
metas.description: A microbrewery owner and a student doctor are brought together by a car accident that injures a stray dog they agree to adopt, forcing them to navigate each other's vulnerabilities.

metas.name: High Potential
metas.description: Morgan is a single mom with an exceptional mind, whose unconventional knack for solving crimes leads to an unusual and unstoppable partnership with a by-the-book seasoned detective.

metas.name: Community
metas.description: A suspended lawyer is forced to enroll in a community college with an eccentric staff and student body.

metas.name: How I Met Your Mother
metas.description: A father recounts to his children the journey he and his four best friends took leading up to him meeting their mother.

metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: The absurd antics of an Indiana town's public officials as they pursue sundry projects to make their city a better place.

metas.name: Family Guy
metas.description: In a wacky Rhode Island town, a dysfunctional family strives to cope with everyday life as they are thrown from one crazy scenario to another.

metas.name: Futurama
metas.description: The adventures of a late-20th-century New York City pizza delivery boy, Philip J. Fry, who, after being unwittingly cryogenically frozen for one thousand years, finds employment at Planet Express, an interplanetary delivery company in the retro-futuristic 31st century.

metas.name: Castle
metas.description: Successful author Richard Castle teams up with NYPD Detective Kate Beckett to solve complex murder cases.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A workplace comedy centered on a group of dedicated teachers - and an oblivious principal - in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life.

metas.name: Chad Powers
metas.description: A disgraced college quarterback named Russ Holliday disguises himself as Chad Powers and walks onto a struggling southern football team to revive his football career.

metas.name: Young Sheldon
metas.description: Meet a child genius named Sheldon Cooper (already seen as an adult in The Big Bang Theory (2007)) and his family. Some unique challenges face Sheldon, who is socially impaired.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: Comedy series following the exploits of Det. Jake Peralta and his diverse, lovable colleagues as they police the NYPD's 99th Precinct.

metas.name: The Paper
metas.description: A documentary crew searching for a new subject finds a dying Midwestern newspaper and its publisher's efforts to revive it using volunteer reporters.

metas.name: Seinfeld
metas.description: The continuing misadventures of neurotic New York City stand-up comedian Jerry Seinfeld and his equally neurotic New York City friends.

metas.name: The Middle
metas.description: The daily mishaps of a married woman and her semi-dysfunctional family and their attempts to survive life in general in the town of Orson, Indiana.

metas.name: Mr Inbetween
metas.description: Ray Shoesmith is a father, ex-husband, boyfriend, brother and best friend; tough roles to juggle in the modern age. Especially, when you're also a criminal for hire.

metas.name: Desperate Housewives
metas.description: A close-knit group of housewives reside in Wisteria Lane. It may appear to be a seemingly perfect neighborhood but it hides many secrets, crimes, forbidden romances and domestic struggles.

metas.name: One Piece
metas.description: With his straw hat and ragtag crew, young pirate Monkey D. Luffy goes on an epic voyage for treasure.

metas.name: Six Feet Under
metas.description: When death is your business, what is your life? Laced with irony and dark situational humor, the show approaches the subject of death through the eyes of the Fisher family, who owns and operates a funeral home in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Curb Your Enthusiasm
metas.description: Larry David stars as an over-the-top version of himself in this comedy series that shows how seemingly trivial details of day-to-day life can precipitate a catastrophic chain of events.

metas.name: DTF St. Louis
metas.description: A darkly comedic tale of three middle-aged individuals entangled in a love triangle, leading to one's untimely demise.

metas.name: Two and a Half Men
metas.description: A hedonistic jingle writer's free-wheeling life comes to an abrupt halt when his brother and 10-year-old nephew move into his beach-front house.

metas.name: The Rehearsal
metas.description: Nathan Fielder gives people a chance to rehearse for their own lives in a world where nothing ever works out as expected.

metas.name: WandaVision
metas.description: Blends the style of classic sitcoms with the MCU, in which Wanda Maximoff and Vision - two super-powered beings living their ideal suburban lives - begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: When a novice sleuth convinces the police he has psychic powers, he and his reluctant best friend are hired on as consultants to help solve complicated cases.

metas.name: Hawaii Five-0
metas.description: When United States Navy officer, Steve McGarrett, returns home to Oahu to find his father's killer, the Governor offers him the chance to run his own special task force: Five-0.

metas.name: Ride or Die
metas.description: Two best friends, Judith and Debbie, discover Judith is secretly an assassin. After a hit goes wrong, they go on the run while being targeted by a mysterious enemy, forcing them to confront the secrets between them.

metas.name: New Girl
metas.description: After a bad break-up, Jess, an offbeat young woman, moves into an apartment loft with three single men. Although they find her behavior very unusual, the men support her - most of the time.

metas.name: Rivals
metas.description: Follows Rupert Campbell-Black and Tony Baddingham as they have a longstanding rivalry that comes to a head.

metas.name: BoJack Horseman
metas.description: BoJack Horseman was the star of the hit television show "Horsin' Around" in the '80s and '90s, but now he's washed up, living in Hollywood, complaining about everything, and wearing colorful sweaters.

metas.name: Sex and the City
metas.description: Four career women navigate life in NYC. Carrie writes about relationships, Charlotte runs an art gallery, Miranda practices law, and Samantha excels in PR. Each brings unique views on love, work, and friendship.

metas.name: Elsbeth
metas.description: Astute but unconventional attorney Elsbeth Tascioni utilizes her singular point of view to make unique observations and corner brilliant criminals alongside the NYPD.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: Liz Lemon, head writer of the sketch-comedy show "TGS with Tracy Jordan", must deal with an arrogant new boss and a crazy new star while trying to run a successful television show without losing her mind.

metas.name: Sex Education
metas.description: A teenage boy with a sex-therapist mother teams up with a high-school classmate to set up an underground sex-therapy clinic at school.

metas.name: Agatha All Along
metas.description: A spell-bound Agatha Harkness regains freedom thanks to a teen's help. Intrigued by his plea, she embarks on the Witches' Road trials to reclaim her powers and discover the teen's motivations.

metas.name: President Curtis
metas.description: Follows President Andre Curtis and his eccentric staff as they deal with various crises that Rick Sanchez typically ignores.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A look into the nightly lives of four vampires who have lived together on Staten Island for over a century.

metas.name: This Is Us
metas.description: A heartwarming and emotional story about a unique set of triplets, their struggles, and their wonderful parents.

metas.name: Peacemaker
metas.description: Picking up where The Suicide Squad (2021) left off, Peacemaker returns home after recovering from his encounter with Bloodsport - only to discover that his freedom comes at a price.

metas.name: All Creatures Great & Small
metas.description: The heartwarming life and work of country vets in the 1930s and 1940s Yorkshire Dales, based on the beloved books by James Herriot.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Level-headed son Michael Bluth takes over family affairs after his father is imprisoned. But the rest of his spoiled, dysfunctional family are making his job unbearable.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: After being a victim of fraud, Johnny Rose and his family go from extremely wealthy to penniless overnight. The only asset left to them is a small, unsophisticated town: Schitt's Creek. They relocate there. Culture shock ensues.

metas.name: The Sex Lives of College Girls
metas.description: Four 18-year-old freshman roommates at Essex College in Vermont. A bundle of contradictions and hormones, these sexually active college girls are equal parts lovable and infuriating.

metas.name: Margo's Got Money Troubles
metas.description: A young mother struggles to make ends meet. When her estranged father offers help, she starts an OnlyFans account using his advice from pro wrestling. Though successful, she wonders if Internet fame comes at too high a cost.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: Bob Belcher runs a struggling burger shop with his wife and three children.

metas.name: Malcolm in the Middle
metas.description: A gifted young teen tries to survive life with his dimwitted, dysfunctional family.

metas.name: Rooster
metas.description: A comedy revolving around an author's intricate bond with his daughter, set against the backdrop of a college campus.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A crash-landed alien takes on the identity of a small-town Colorado doctor and slowly begins to wrestle with the moral dilemma of his secret mission on Earth.

metas.name: Leanne
metas.description: A grandmother's life is upended when her husband leaves her after 33 years of marriage. She navigates this new chapter with the help of her family, grace, dignity, and jello salad.

metas.name: Avatar: The Last Airbender
metas.description: A young boy known as the Avatar must master the four elemental powers to save the world, and fight against an enemy bent on stopping him.

metas.name: Atlanta
metas.description: Earn and his cousin Alfred try to make their way in the world through Atlanta's rap scene. Along the way they come face-to-face with social and economic issues touching on race, relationships, poverty, status, and parenthood.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: Former Senator Selina Meyer finds that being Vice President of the United States is nothing like she hoped and everything that everyone ever warned her about.

metas.name: The Studio
metas.description: Follows a legacy Hollywood movie studio striving to survive in a world where it is increasingly difficult for art and business to live together.

metas.name: The Righteous Gemstones
metas.description: Follows a world-famous televangelist family with a long tradition of deviance, greed, and charitable work.

metas.name: The Four Seasons
metas.description: Three suburban couples vacation together each season, but tensions arise when one couple splits up and the husband brings a much younger woman on subsequent trips.

metas.name: The Good Place
metas.description: Eleanor Shellstrop, a deceased saleswoman who lived a morally corrupt life, finds herself in a heaven-like afterlife in a case of mistaken identity and tries to hide her past in order to stay there.

metas.name: Orange Is the New Black
metas.description: Convicted of a decade-old crime of transporting drug money, ordinarily law-abiding Piper Chapman is sentenced to 18 months behind bars and quickly discovers the realities of life-changing prison time.

metas.name: Frasier
metas.description: Dr. Frasier Crane moves back to his hometown of Seattle, where he lives with his father and works as a radio psychiatrist.

metas.name: Saved by the Bell
metas.description: A close-knit group of six friends get through their teens together while attending Bayside High School in Palisades, California.

metas.name: Cobra Kai
metas.description: Decades after their 1984 All Valley Karate Tournament bout, a middle-aged Daniel LaRusso and Johnny Lawrence find themselves martial-arts rivals again.
